intended_use_case: An AI assistant that reads customers' Gmail and Google Calendar
overview: Google APIs use OAuth 2.0 with client credentials from a Google Cloud project, a configured consent screen, and exact-match redirect URIs. Building and testing is quick: in Testing mode up to 100 named test users can authorize, but their grants expire after seven days. Launching to any Google user with sensitive or restricted scopes requires Google's OAuth app verification. Gmail and Drive scopes are restricted, which adds an annual security assessment by a Google-approved third party if data passes through your servers. Google says restricted-scope verification can take several weeks. That makes it the longest and least predictable part of this integration.

recommended_path.summary: For a multi-tenant assistant that reads Gmail, register your own Google Cloud OAuth client and plan for restricted-scope verification and a CASA security assessment. Avoid restricted scopes where a narrower scope works. Use internal (Workspace-only) apps or testing mode until verification completes.

options.title: Your own Google Cloud OAuth client
options.summary: Full control of scopes and branding; you own verification, the security assessment, and annual re-verification.
options.when_to_choose: Production SaaS that needs Gmail or Calendar data from many customers.
tradeoffs: Restricted scopes add a third-party security assessment and annual re-verification

options.title: Use an integration platform's managed Google app
options.summary: A platform that has already passed verification supplies the OAuth client.
options.when_to_choose: Early pilots, if the platform's app already covers your scopes.
tradeoffs: Consent screen shows the platform's brand
Restricted-scope data still flows through the platform's assessed servers; check their scope coverage (not verified here)

effort_estimate.basis: Recomputed from steps at load time.

external_wait.summary: Brand verification ~2–3 business days; sensitive scopes ~3–5 business days; restricted scopes (Gmail) potentially several weeks, plus a third-party security assessment.
external_wait.range_text: Days (sensitive) to several weeks or more (restricted)
external_wait.explanation: These are Google's typical durations, not guarantees. The duration and cost of the third-party security assessment (CASA) are not documented on the checked pages.

approval_summary: Required for a public multi-tenant app requesting sensitive or restricted scopes. Exceptions exist for personal use, testing, service-owned data, internal Workspace apps, and domain-wide installation.

prerequisites.title: Google Cloud project and OAuth client credentials
prerequisites.detail: Create OAuth 2.0 client credentials in the Google API Console / Cloud Console.

prerequisites.title: Verified domain, homepage and privacy policy
prerequisites.detail: Verification requires ownership of the consent screen's authorized domains and accurate branding and policy links.

prerequisites.title: Budget and owner for a security assessment (restricted scopes)
prerequisites.detail: Restricted-scope data handled on your servers requires an annual assessment by a Google-approved assessor.

setup_steps.title: Create a Google Cloud project (separate projects for test and prod)
setup_steps.explanation: Create a project to hold the consent screen and OAuth clients. Google recommends separate projects for development/testing and production.
setup_steps.why_it_matters: Verification applies per project; mixing environments complicates review.
setup_steps.expected_outcome: Dedicated projects for development and production.

setup_steps.title: Configure the OAuth consent screen and audience
setup_steps.explanation: Set app name, support email, homepage, privacy policy and authorized domains. Choose External (any Google account) or Internal (your Workspace organization only). Leave publishing status as Testing while building.
setup_steps.why_it_matters: Branding and domains are checked in verification; Internal apps avoid verification for org-only use.
setup_steps.expected_outcome: A consent screen in Testing with test users added.

setup_steps.title: Create a Web application OAuth client with exact redirect URIs
setup_steps.explanation: Create OAuth client credentials and register every redirect URI. The redirect URI in requests must exactly match a registered one.
setup_steps.why_it_matters: Mismatches cause redirect_uri_mismatch errors at sign-in.
setup_steps.expected_outcome: A client ID and secret with registered redirect URIs.

setup_steps.title: Pick the narrowest scopes and check their category
setup_steps.explanation: List the Gmail and Calendar scopes you need. The Cloud Console labels each as non-sensitive, sensitive or restricted. Gmail and Drive scopes are restricted, so prefer narrower alternatives where they work, and request scopes incrementally.
setup_steps.why_it_matters: Scope category decides which verification path (and timeline) applies.
setup_steps.expected_outcome: A scope list with categories and a justification for each.

setup_steps.title: Implement the web-server flow with PKCE and refresh tokens
setup_steps.explanation: Redirect to Google's authorization endpoint, exchange the code at the token endpoint, store refresh tokens securely, and handle refresh-token limits per client-user.
setup_steps.why_it_matters: Over the per-user limits, older refresh tokens silently stop working.
setup_steps.expected_outcome: Users connect once, and the assistant keeps access through refresh.

setup_steps.title: Test with up to 100 test users
setup_steps.explanation: Add test users on the consent screen. They see a warning, and their authorizations (and refresh tokens) expire seven days after consent.
setup_steps.why_it_matters: Seven-day expiry means pilots need re-consent weekly until you are verified and in production.
setup_steps.expected_outcome: End-to-end testing with real accounts before verification.

setup_steps.title: Prepare and submit OAuth app verification
setup_steps.explanation: Confirm policy compliance, verify domain ownership, declare all scopes with justifications, and record a demo video showing how each sensitive and restricted scope is used. Submit in the Verification Center.
setup_steps.why_it_matters: Incomplete submissions restart the clock on a multi-week process.

setup_steps.title: Complete the restricted-scope security assessment (CASA)
setup_steps.explanation: If restricted-scope data is accessed from or through your servers, engage a Google-approved assessor. Re-verify at least every 12 months after the Letter of Assessment.
setup_steps.why_it_matters: Without it, restricted scopes such as Gmail are not approved for public use.
setup_steps.expected_outcome: A Letter of Assessment and approved restricted scopes.

setup_steps.title: Switch publishing status to In production
setup_steps.explanation: Once verified, publish the app so any Google account can authorize it without test-user limits. Unverified apps showing the unverified-app screen are limited to 100 new users.
setup_steps.why_it_matters: Publishing before verification exposes users to warnings and caps.
setup_steps.expected_outcome: Customers can connect without warnings or user caps.

testing_plan.title: Run the full flow with test users
testing_plan.detail: Add up to 100 test users and confirm consent, token exchange and API calls.

testing_plan.title: Exercise the seven-day expiry
testing_plan.detail: Confirm the app detects expired test-user grants and asks users to reconnect.

testing_plan.title: Verify redirect URIs in every environment
testing_plan.detail: Check exact matches for local, staging and production callbacks.

blockers_and_unknowns.title: Gmail requires restricted-scope verification and a security assessment
blockers_and_unknowns.detail: Public apps reading Gmail through your servers need a Google-approved third-party assessment, repeated annually.
blockers_and_unknowns.mitigation: Use narrower scopes where possible, start the assessment early, or limit launch to internal Workspace customers first.

blockers_and_unknowns.title: Security assessment duration and cost
blockers_and_unknowns.detail: Google says restricted verification can take several weeks but does not document assessor time or cost.
blockers_and_unknowns.mitigation: Get quotes from approved assessors before committing to a launch date.

blockers_and_unknowns.title: Seven-day expiry in Testing
blockers_and_unknowns.detail: Pilot users must re-consent weekly until the app is in production.
blockers_and_unknowns.mitigation: Plan pilots around re-consent, or use an Internal app for your own organization.

blockers_and_unknowns.title: 100 new-user cap while unverified
blockers_and_unknowns.detail: Unverified apps showing the unverified-app screen are limited to 100 new users.

context_variations.personal: Personal use by you (or a few people you know) is exempt from verification; you can proceed through the unverified-app screen.
context_variations.internal: Set the consent screen to Internal in a project owned by your Workspace organization; verification isn't required, but admins may need to allow restricted Gmail/Drive scopes.
context_variations.multi_tenant_saas: External audience plus sensitive and restricted scopes: plan for verification and, for Gmail, an annual third-party security assessment.
